diagnosis: The logistics quote retrieval endpoint queries an in-memory NodeCache instance using an un-scoped key derived solely from req.params.quoteId. Cached freight quotes contain negotiated commercial discounts and shipper contact details. Any authenticated user can enumerate or submit another company's quoteId to inspect confidential pricing and shipping routes.
